# GetCameraBuffer <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Cameras](Blitz3D-Cameras)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GetCameraBuffer:Int32 camera:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `camera` | In | Int32 | required | Camera handle. |

**Returns:** The buffer, or 0 if the camera draws into the buffer of SetBuffer. A buffer of a texture that was freed gives 0.

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Gives the buffer that a camera always draws into, set by [SetCameraBuffer](SetCameraBuffer). This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
camera = CreateCamera()
Print GetCameraBuffer(camera) ; 0
SetCameraBuffer camera, BackBuffer()
Print GetCameraBuffer(camera) = BackBuffer() ; 1
```
